product_metadata.title: Carol Wright Gifts Quilted Air Conditioner Cover,White Size SM
description: Now you don't have to remove your heavy air conditioner in the winter. Simply conceal it with this attractive, quilted cover that eliminates dust, dirt and cold drafts while preventing heat loss. Made of machine-washable polyester and cotton with elasticized edges for a neat, tailored fit. Available in sizes: Small(14"Hx20"Wx33/4"D), Medium(17"Hx24"Wx33/4"D) or Large(20"Hx28"Wx33/4"D)
